headline: Unauthorized users reach Anthropic's withheld Mythos — darker endings rise
body: The biggest single-day drop in mood so far. Bloomberg reported that a Discord group got into Claude Mythos Preview, a cyber-capable model Anthropic had deliberately withheld, through a third-party contractor's environment; Anthropic said its own systems were not affected. A restricted model leaking out weakens Alignment & Control and raises Catastrophic Risk, which lifts Self-Destruction and Conquerors and pulls down Protector God and Libertarian Utopia. In London, the High Court ruled the Met Police's live facial recognition policy lawful, though the claimants plan to appeal. That strengthens Surveillance & Control and pushes 1984 up. Alibaba also previewed its strongest model, Qwen 3.6-Max. Horizon Balance fell to +1.94, down 1.11.
movers_note: Self-Destruction +0.8 and Conquerors +0.7 came from the Mythos unauthorized-access story (+0.76 and +0.68), which also drove Protector God -0.7; 1984 +0.5 came from the UK facial-recognition ruling (+0.54).
